faqs.a:
The resolution described in the preceding section, a separate resolution or the ordinance
               creating the improvement district may combine or may divide the proposed project appertaining
               to the district and any other facilities into suitable construction units for the
               purpose of letting separate and independent contracts, regardless of the extent of
               any project constituting an assessment unit and regardless of whether a portion or
               none of the cost of any project is to be defrayed other than by the levy of special
               assessments.
(Code 1981, § 27-41; Ord. No. 551, § 16(C), 5-14-1964)
